recognize_zh: 整個視野幾乎都是只剩淡粉紅細胞膜輪廓的「鬼影細胞」（ghost cells），代表成人血紅素 HbA 已被酸洗脫；只有中央一顆紅血球染色稍深，這是 Kleihauer-Betke 酸洗脫法的判讀畫面。
features: Nearly all red cells appear as pale 'ghost' cells with only a faint pink membrane outline and empty interior (HbA eluted)
A single red cell near the center retains slightly more diffuse pink staining, of intermediate intensity
No clearly dark, uniformly stained HbF-containing (fetal) cells in this field
Cells lie in cohesive sheets and chains; background shows fine eosinophilic precipitate
describe_en: Kleihauer-Betke acid elution preparation of peripheral blood shows red cells almost entirely converted to pale ghost cells, indicating elution of acid-labile adult hemoglobin. A single cell in the center retains slightly denser pink staining, but no clearly intensely stained fetal-type (HbF-rich) cells are identified in this field. Findings represent a predominantly negative field; quantitation requires counting fetal cells across many fields (typically 2,000 cells) against an adult control.

ddx.vs: A positive maternal sample shows a discrete population of brightly eosinophilic, uniformly stained fetal cells among ghost cells, rather than a nearly all-ghost field.

ddx.dx: Heterocellular increase in HbF (F cells in hemoglobinopathy)
ddx.vs: F cells show variable, often intermediate staining in a subset of cells, which can mimic fetal cells and requires flow cytometry for anti-HbF/anti-carbonic anhydrase to separate.

ddx.dx: Pancellular hereditary persistence of fetal hemoglobin
ddx.vs: In pancellular HPFH essentially all red cells retain moderate, even staining rather than appearing as ghosts.
